name: Own-savings standing order the salary account cannot fund, 500 spare in another current account (G422)

expected.notes: G422 (Kevin 2026-11-06), read under G438 (Kevin 2026-11-07). Today Wed 25 Nov 2026, pay period last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov and the window is 25 and 26 Nov. Barclays Current holds 50 and carries one standing order of 250 into Barclays Saver (savings, in no pool), dated Thu 26 Nov. Monzo Current holds 500 and has nothing due. The order is an ordinary predicted payment on Barclays: 50 - 250 = -200 after payments and at the low point, short. At risk count 1 (the bounced 250 order). The quiet unfunded-move item stays out because the order is not yet due. The 200 gap is an ordinary shortfall with an ordinary cover move: target ceil5(200) + 10 cushion = 210. Monzo headroom = 500 - 10 = 490 covers it alone, so one move of 210 from Monzo to Barclays; the saver the order pays into is never a source of its own cover. Earmarks: Monzo set aside 210, Spend from 500 - 210 = 290. Barclays short after cover = max(0, 200 - 210) = 0 and its Spend from is its 10 cushion, spendable only after the suggested move. Left to spend: the pool is the two counted current accounts 50 + 500 = 550 (the saver is in no pool), the 250 leaves the pool because its destination is not pooled, so 550 - 250 = 300 = Monzo 290 + Barclays 10. Nothing is moved by the app: the card is a recommendation. The payday plan is null: a habitual transfer is not a plan row (G402).
